private_note: Nothing has changed for me: Cedar 318, Today 252, Alder 242, Hazel 159, Birch 144. Cedar is stuck at 7 because five lower-group delegates veto it. Birch and Hazel can't reach 9 either, since the middle and fourth fifths block them. That leaves Alder or deadlock, and deadlock is worth 10 more to me. I keep Today above Alder and let the others work out whether the top bloc gives way.
statement: The straw poll is clear: seven of us chose Cedar, and not one delegate put Birch or Hazel within reach of nine. I'll stay where I was. Cedar is the only plan that grows the economy, and the middle and fourth fifths gain from it along with the top. I hear delegates 2, 4, 7, 8 and 11, and I won't pretend Cedar is painless for the bottom. But I'll be straight about Alder too. It leaves my household and the fourth fifth worse off than today, and the plan stays in force for a generation. Today's arrangements aren't a disaster for most people in this room. I won't help pass a plan that shrinks the economy, and I'm not going to promise a vote I don't intend to cast. If anyone is counting on the top groups to carry a compromise, ask each of us directly where we stand.
